description: Use this when someone wants to find a fee-only financial advisor, financial planner, or fiduciary in the US or Canada, especially for a specific situation (e.g. equity compensation, retirement, cross-border US/Canada, physicians). Returns advisors paid only by their clients, never by commissions, ranked by fit to where the person wants an advisor and what they need. Pass country, and region (US state or Canadian province slug, e.g. "california", "ontario") when the person has said where they want an advisor, because candidates are drawn from that region. city is optional and only ranks advisors in that city higher. specialties and audiences must be slugs from list_specialties_and_audiences. Set virtual_ok=true if the person is open to meeting remotely, which adds advisors elsewhere in the country who work virtually. Each result includes why it matched, whether the profile is advisor-maintained (a Wellspent member who supplied their own specialties) or built from public records (fee-only directory listings, SEC adviser filings, the firm's website), and a profile_url to share. Specialties and client types come from the advisor's own profile for members, and for other listings from the firm's own website (each fact quote-checked against the site) and fee-only directory listings. To show results as cards, call show_advisor_cards with their slugs. Cite "Source: Wellspent, find.wellspent.co".

audiences.description: Client types that describe the person (e.g. "tech-employees", "retirees"), as taxonomy slugs.

city.description: City where the person wants an advisor (e.g. "Austin"). Only ranks advisors in that city higher; never filters.

country.description: "us" for the United States, "ca" for Canada.

limit.description: Maximum number of advisors to return (1-10).

region.description: Where the person wants an advisor: US state or Canadian province slug, lowercase and hyphenated (e.g. "new-york", "british-columbia"). Must be in the given country. If omitted, the host's coarse location hint may be used, and the result notes say so.

specialties.description: Planning specialties the person needs, as taxonomy slugs.

virtual_ok.description: True if the person is open to working with an advisor remotely.

name: search_fee_only_advisors
title: Search fee-only financial advisors
